title: Semantic review packet, version semantic-review-packet/1.0
description: The file contract between a Salmon Data Package tool (metasalmon or metasalmonpy) and a harness that judges ontology candidates. The tool writes a packet (this schema's root, $defs/packet); the harness writes an assessment CSV whose thirty columns are $defs/assessment_row, in that order, and beside it a one-line sidecar <csv>.packet-id holding the packet_id it judged (the frozen row has nowhere to carry it; the tool refuses a file that names no packet, code packet_unbound, or a different one, code packet_mismatch); the tool reads the CSV back, redacts secrets from the harness-owned free-text columns at capture, and persists the same thirty columns as its record, plus a findings CSV of $defs/findings_row. This copy is vendored byte-identically in both packages. Canonical serialisation: UTF-8 with no byte-order mark, two-space indent, one member per line, a colon and one space between a key and its value, empty containers inline as [] and {}, a single trailing line feed, only the double quote, the backslash and U+0000 to U+001F escaped (\", \\, \b, \f, \n, \r, \t, and \u00XX in lower-case hex for the rest), true/false/null literals, and numbers rendered by value: a finite whole number as an integer literal with no decimal point, any other finite number as the shortest decimal that round-trips in plain notation (never scientific), NaN and infinities as null. Key order is fixed per object as listed here. packet_id is the SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical serialisation with the packet_id and producer members removed, so the same packet built by either implementation has the same id and the id is an integrity check at ingest.

packet.description: Members in this order: packet_version, packet_id, pass, parent_packet_id, producer, pins, instructions, decision_vocabulary, decision_aliases, output, context, units.

parent_packet_id.description: null at pass 1; the pass-1 packet's id at pass 2.

producer.description: The only member excluded from packet_id together with packet_id itself, and the only member that may differ between the two implementations on the same inputs.

version.description: The SDP profile version of the vendored schema bundle, never of a remote load.

ontologies.description: Nothing pins an ontology today: retrieval reads live endpoints. pinned is therefore false, and the packet records the sources that were searched and, for a package path, the sources that failed to answer.

ranking_identity.description: metasalmon's ranking identity string for a package path; null otherwise, and always null from metasalmonpy (parity row 39).

retrieval.description: What the ingester needs to widen a shortlist at pass 1: the depth and the source policy.

code_scope.description: Which codes.csv values got a slot when a blank slot was recovered by discovery for a package path (create_sdp's semantic_code_scope). Nothing in a package records the scope it was created with, so the packet records the one used; a blank code-level slot outside it is reported by the exporter as not covered, never silently dropped.

effective_sources_by_role.description: One member per bundle role, in the order variable, property, entity, unit, constraint, statistical_modifier, method.

instructions.description: The vendored instructions file, verbatim. Byte-identical in both packages.

file.description: review/semantic-assessments-pass-1.csv or review/semantic-assessments-pass-2.csv, relative to the package directory.

owner.description: harness: the harness fills it. package: the package fills it and overwrites anything the harness wrote, with one warning naming the columns. harness_or_package: the harness may declare an error there; otherwise the package writes it.

required.description: always: required on every row. accept: required when the decision is accept. retry_search: required when the decision is retry_search. never: optional or package-owned.

source.description: The label the excerpts carry: a file's basename, disambiguated with its parent directory on a collision, or inline_context[n].

sha256.description: A file: the digest of its bytes. Inline text: the digest of the UTF-8 text.

units.description: Sorted by unit_key in C collation.

unit.description: Members in this order: unit_kind, unit_key, dictionary, current_slots, slots, context_excerpts; a pass-2 bundle unit adds previous_findings. A bundle unit is one measurement column with one slot per targeted I-ADOPT role; a target unit is one slot on its own. A unit may hold a slot with no candidates.

dictionary.description: The dictionary row's context, every key present, null when the row does not carry it or when the target is not a column.

current_slots.description: A bundle unit: the current value of each of the six dictionary slot fields, keyed by role in the order variable, property, entity, unit, constraint, statistical_modifier. A target unit: empty.

context_excerpts.description: At most four, scored against the unit's targets and candidates, deduplicated across the unit, in score order.

previous_findings.description: Pass 2, bundle units only: the pass-1 findings for this unit.

slot.description: Members in this order: dictionary_role, target_sdp_field, status, current_value, slot_id, identity, target, candidates; a pass-2 slot adds reassess and previous_assessment. identity is the nine columns the harness copies into its row; target is the frozen 19-column semantic target row.

current_value.description: The slot's value in the package before review: null when blank, otherwise the value, which may carry the REVIEW: marker.

target.description: The 19 target columns, in the frozen order.

candidates.description: Retrieval order, which is the ranked order; index is the 1-based position and the only way a harness names a candidate.

reassess.description: Pass 2 only: whether this slot gained candidates and is to be judged again. A slot with reassess false keeps its pass-1 answer.

previous_assessment.description: Pass 2 only: the slot's full pass-1 row, after retry bookkeeping.

candidate.description: Members in this order: index, label, iri, source, ontology, role, match_type, definition, term_type, resource_kind, type_iris, native_type, role_hints, role_hint_status, role_hint_bonus, lexical_score, alignment_only, agreement_sources, retrieval_query, retrieval_pass, role_collision, role_collision_note, extra. There is no candidate id: selection is by index, because the two implementations fingerprint a blank-IRI candidate differently. extra holds every other candidate column, keys in C order, excluding the target columns, the review console's decision columns, assessment output (llm_*) and internal keys.

role.description: The candidate's ontology role as retrieval labelled it.

native_type.description: Derived from term_type, resource_kind and type_iris by the validators' classifier; carried so a harness sees the type the validators will read.

assessment_row.description: The frozen 30-column assessment row, in this order. In the harness's CSV every cell is text and the empty field is the only missing value; the ownership and requiredness of each column is given in the packet's output.columns. In the packet (previous_assessment) the same row is an object with null for a missing cell, numbers for llm_confidence, llm_selected_candidate_index and llm_exploration_candidate_gain, and a boolean for llm_exploration_used.

findings_row.description: One bundle validator finding: the nine columns of review/semantic-validator-findings.csv, in this order.
